column3: Upon the Empire Mall Mortgage Loan becoming a specially serviced loan under the WFCM 2025-5C7 PSA, the related Non-Serviced Special Servicer under the WFCM 2025-5C7 PSA will earn a special servicing fee payable monthly with respect to the Mortgage Loan accruing at a rate equal to the greater of (i) a per annum rate of 0.25% and (ii) the per annum rate that would result in a special servicing fee of $5,000 for the related month until the Special Servicing Loan Event (as defined in the WFCM 2025-5C7 PSA) no longer exists.
